method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core with five regulative rules (DEONTIC) and a seat layer of 20 exported questions; no REFUSE (gaps answer an explicit not-covered value, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Duties Act 1997 No 123 (act-1997-123), corpus document nsw_legislation:2025-01-01/act-1997-123 (version date 2025-01-01, scraped 2025-03-10), from the Open Australian Legal Corpus version 7.1.0, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1997-123.txt. NOT THE CURRENT OFFICIAL TEXT; IT MAY BE OUT OF DATE. The s 32 table holds the 2019-20 amounts; later years' amounts (s 33AC, s 33AD, s 33AF notice, not deposited) are inputs. The formulas in s 78A(2), (2A) and s 78B(3) are missing from the corpus text. Brought in: First Home Owner Grant and Shared Equity Act 2000 (act-2000-021, corpus version 2023-09-04), read only for s 4A (s 74(5), out of scope).

regulative_rules: ss 15, 16, 16A: lodge the instrument or a written statement, with the purchaser's declaration, within 3 months
s 17: pay the duty within 3 months to avoid a tax default
s 104W: pay surcharge purchaser duty within 3 months to avoid a tax default
s 76A(2): if the residence requirement is not met, give written notice and pay the relevant duty within 14 days after the period allowed for compliance
s 262: lodge a statement of the dutiable value with the application to register a motor vehicle
scope: IN: Chapter 2 ss 8, 11(1)(a), 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 16A, 17, 21, 32 (2019-20 table), 32A (premium rate, s 32A(3) residential land), 33AB-33AF (s 33AC and s 33AD as functions, s 33AF amounts as inputs); Part 8 Division 1 ss 70, 71, 73, 73A, 74(1)-(3), 75, 76, 76A(2)-(3), 78A(1), 78B(1), (2), (6); Part 8 Division 4 ss 104A-104C (s 104C factor an input); Chapter 2A ss 104G, 104I, 104J (foreign person a fact), 104K, 104L, 104R, 104U, 104V, 104W, 104Z, 104ZK(2); Chapter 9 ss 261-266, 267(1), (6), (6A), (7), (7A), (7AA), (7B), 268; Schedule 1 cl 147, cl 156 as date limits. NOT COVERED (asserted): s 78A(2), (2A) and s 78B(3) formulas (missing from the corpus), ss 32B, 32C, s 104C beyond a supplied factor, s 104ZB, s 104ZKA, s 104ZKB, general-rate liabilities before 1 July 2019, scheme agreements before 1 July 2023, surcharge liabilities before 1 January 2025. OUT: s 78AA, s 74(4)-(5), Division 1A, s 49A, s 18, s 18A and property tax, Chapters 4, 7 and 8, other exemptions, s 267(2)-(5), (8), ss 269-270C, s 273, Taxation Administration Act 1996 matters. No pensioner or seniors concession appears in the deposited Act.
